question: Ajay offers his customers a discount of 20% on an overcoat and he still makes a profit of 28%. What is the actual cost of the overcoat marked at ₹1,800?
solution:
Given:

Discount is given on Marked Price = 20%

Profit earned = 28%

Formula used:

S.P. = M.P. - Discount % of M.P.

C.P. = (S.P. × 100)/(100 + P)

Mark up% = {(M.P. - C.P.)/C.P.} × 100</
